choices.reason: No rule separates the candidates on the available evidence: both report the same full-sample technology main effect, and neither the paper nor its abstract/introduction identifies one analysis as primary over the other; the linked preregistration could not be retrieved. The pooled record has participant-level means and SDs but lacks arm counts and data_stats, so the complete statistics specified in rule 3 are unavailable; OSF retrieval also failed and no local data archive was present, while rules 4-6 do not distinguish these analyses of the same sample and arms.
